note: ArtCNN (Artoriuz/ArtCNN, MIT licence, compatible with PushMPC's GPL-3.0) luma doublers PushMPC uses on macOS: the ONNX files are converted by vsplugin/tools/artcnn_tool.py into .pmnn weights for the Metal engine (apple backend) and into fragment-shader GLSL for OpenGL-only renderers (IINA's GL 4.1, any GL-only mpv); the upstream compute GLSL is used as-is by the mpv gpu-next / Vulkan profile. Every file is fetched from an immutable commit URL and checked against its SHA-256 (and git blob SHA-1). ArtCNN is trained on anime / art content: Auto uses it first for anime, and for live action only when VideoToolbox's editing-grade super resolution is not available.
